description: This file exports a custom React hook called useDebouncedEffect that delays the execution of a side-effect until after a specified delay following the last change in dependencies. It utilizes React's useEffect to set up and clean up a timeout, implementing debounce behavior in React functional components.

methods.name: useDebouncedEffect(effect, deps, delay = 400)
methods.description: A custom React hook that delays the execution of the provided effect function until after a specified delay period has passed without any changes to dependencies.
